title: The icon class of a repeated Joomla row joins the group of its row, so label rule R4 passes for repeated items
steps: S1: Run the slot role rule tables (proposeContentMapRoles, vocabulary place-content-roles/3) on a fictional social block whose label and link slots share one group per network, with one icon class not yet roled and one icon carried over with the role editorial.item_icon but no group.
S2: Run label rule R4 (labelRulesOf) on the map before and after, and the content map roles check on the result.
expect: S1: both icons get the group of the label and link of their own row; an icon of a row nobody grouped keeps no group.
S2: R4 names the carried icon before and neither icon after; the roles check reports no error.
evidence: JA Boxing j6 1.0.10: label rule R4 failed on 8 icon slots (module-171 social-intro[font-icon], module-180 hero[social-intro][font-icon]) whose label and link siblings were grouped per network
fence: Unit test of the rule tables on a fictional fixture; the released 1.0.10 content map is not changed

tests: an icon of a repeated row joins the group of its row, so each repeated item is one group (label rule R4)
